Hi,
I never worked with bigTable, but dplyr has an interface to bigQuery. See more here:

https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/dplyr/vignettes/databases.html
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/23668671/how-to-create-bigquery-tbl-using-dplyr

When using dplyr, you can interface with various databases. I worked with sqlite and mysql and in both cases it worked well. Since it has an interface to bigQuery too, i'm sure it won't be too difficult.

Omri
